data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of $142,768,000 (2015: $104,327,000) is a release of $3,362,000 from claims reserves established at the prior year (2015: release $1,923,000).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Notable risk loss on the Specie & Cargo account contributing to reserve deterioration on prior years (absorbed by short-tail property/specie portfolio).
Absorbed losses by short-tail Property classes; referenced as an event that was absorbed while overall 2014 produced a profit.
A notable risk loss on the Energy account that impacted the 2014 underwriting year results and reserves.

named_events.loss_description: Loss activity reflects Hurricane Matthew; noted as part of higher than normal frequency of catastrophe events in the US affecting 2016 results.
Short tail Property classes benefited from a relatively low level of catastrophe events despite absorbing losses from Hurricane Odile.
The SpaceX satellite loss on the Specie & Cargo account was a notable risk loss impacting results.

data.standardized_narrative: At the 2016 year end the syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year (31 Dec 2015) was $165.426m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $13.5m (around 8.2% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven principally by deterioration in the 2014 underwriting year (notably large losses such as the SpaceX satellite and an Energy account loss) partially offset by small releases in older years. The report also separately notes a net prior-year release on a net-of-reinsurance basis of $3.362m. The movements are therefore mixed by vintage but net to an overall strengthening of reserves on a gross basis.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience has been noteworthy on Property Treaty, Property Direct & Facultative and Property Binding Authority. Loss activity reflects Hurricane Matthew, an increase in US designated catastrophes, notably in respect of flood and hail losses, and the SpaceX satellite.
Included within net claims incurred of $142,768,000 (2015: $104,327,000) is a release of $3,362,000 from claims reserves established at the prior year (2015: release $1,923,000).
There were two other notable risk losses on the Energy account and the SpaceX satellite loss on the Specie & Cargo account.
The short tail Property classes contributed significantly to this profit. These classes benefited from a relatively low level of catastrophe events despite absorbing losses from Hurricane Odile.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the prior-year comparative in the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding $165,426k). A gross prior-year movement was derived from the GROSS claims development triangle (calculation excludes the two most recent underwriting years per methodology); the narrative contains only a net prior-year release ($3,362k) which is NET of reinsurance - the triangle was used to compute the GROSS PYD. No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision (gross)' was provided. RITC items are present elsewhere in the report (2014 year closure) but were not judged to invalidate the triangle calculation for prior-year vintages <=2014.
